item.title: Fort Pierce mother leaves nursing career as childcare costs consume 20% of household income
item.description: Siedah White estimated childcare for her four children ranged from $275 per week for toddlers to $300 per week for infants, forcing her to become a full-time mom.

item.title: Delray Beach resident grows front yard garden as cyclosporiasiasis cases reach Martin and St. Lucie counties
item.description: Ryan Boylston turned his suburban front yard into rows of edible plants including spinach, lettuce, arugula, star fruit, bananas, peppers, pineapple and herbs as food safety concerns rise.

item.title: Fort Pierce child care crisis forces mother to leave nursing job
item.description: Siedah White of Fort Pierce left her job as a certified nurse assistant after child care costs for her four children took up about 20 percent of her household income.

item.title: Fort Pierce mother leaves job as CNA due to childcare costs consuming 20% of household income
item.description: Siedah White of Fort Pierce said she was paying $300 per week per infant and $275 a week for toddlers, leading her to leave her job as a certified nurse assistant and become a full-time mom.

item.title: Motorcyclist dies in Vero Beach crash after traveling 113 mph on U.S. Highway 1
item.description: A 25-year-old man died after crashing his motorcycle at the intersection of Eighth Avenue and 21st Street in Vero Beach on July 17 while traveling at speeds over 100 mph, police said Wednesday.

item.title: Palm City dog trainer trial delayed for eighth time as judge voices frustration in Martin County court
item.description: Tempers flared in a Martin County courtroom Tuesday as Judge Elizabeth Metzger pressed both prosecution and defense over why the animal cruelty case against Nikki Camerlengo still hasn't gone to trial more than two years after charges were filed.

item.title: Second arrest made in fatal shooting of Fort Pierce art teacher Andre Leonard Barnes
item.description: Dale A. Mincey, 41, Barnes' nephew, was formally charged with first-degree murder Saturday in connection with the July 7 shooting on the 2700 block of Essex Drive.

item.title: Palm Beach County man arrested after leading Martin County deputies on 100 mph chase through Indiantown
item.description: A 33-year-old man led Martin County deputies on a high-speed chase through Indiantown after driving more than 100 mph on State Road 710.

item.title: Family files wrongful death lawsuit against Urban Air Adventure Park in Port St. Lucie after girl killed in go-kart crash
item.description: A wrongful death lawsuit was filed Monday against Urban Air Trampoline and Adventure Park in Port St. Lucie after 6-year-old Emma Riddle died in a go-kart crash at the facility in December 2025.

item.title: Hobe Sound couple seeks community support as husband battles head and neck cancer
item.description: A Hobe Sound couple is asking for community support as they navigate a cancer diagnosis, holding onto faith every step of the way.

item.title: Some Villa Del Sol residents return home nearly 2 years after structural damage forced evacuation
item.description: Villa Del Sol residents in St. Lucie County told WPTV they are able to return home after nearly two years of being displaced from their condos following structural damage found in August 2024.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK route in September, citing low demand
item.description: JetBlue is ending its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport on Sept. 9, just nine months after the route launched in December.

item.title: Port St. Lucie couple fights rezoning of lot behind their home, says voices went unheard
item.description: A Port St. Lucie couple is searching for answers after the city council voted to rezone the lot behind their home from residential to commercial, despite their months-long opposition.

item.title: Messi bathed Yamal as baby in 2007 photo shoot, now they meet in World Cup final
item.description: A 2007 charity calendar photo shoot paired teenage Lionel Messi with infant Lamine Yamal. Now 19 years later, they face off in Sunday's World Cup final.

item.title: President Trump to Attend World Cup Final in New Jersey with Stepped-Up Security
item.description: The World Cup final Sunday in New Jersey has been designated a Level 1 Special Event with President Trump attending the trophy presentation and enhanced security from multiple federal agencies.

item.title: Major League Baseball Restricts iPad Use in Dugouts to Block AI Decision-Making
item.description: MLB has made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible starting Wednesday to prevent teams from using artificial intelligence to make in-game decisions about substitutions and pitch calling.

item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks mile world record with 3:42.66 run in London
item.description: Josh Kerr shattered a 27-year-old world record on Saturday, running the mile in 3:42.66 at a Diamond League event in London.

item.title: Boca Raton TLC Program Offers Summer Service Projects for South Florida Families
item.description: B'nai Torah Congregation's TLC Program connects volunteers with hands-on service projects ranging from food support and shoe donations to pantry stocking and literacy efforts.

item.title: Palm Beach County Food Bank serves 2,500 hot meals daily to children at 35 summer sites
item.description: The Palm Beach County Food Bank in Lake Worth Beach is serving approximately 2,500 hot meals each day to nearly 1,250 children through Florida's Summer BreakSpot program while school is out.

item.title: Downtown Delray Beach launches Wellness Pass with free fitness classes and spa deals for July and August
item.description: The Delray Beach Downtown Development Authority launched the Downtown Delray Wellness Pass for July and August. The mobile-exclusive pass allows users to access complimentary classes, discounted wellness treatments and promotions from participating businesses.

item.title: Delray Beach dance studio hosts Bridgerton masquerade gala July 24 for ninth anniversary
item.description: Fred Astaire Dance Studios Delray Beach is celebrating nine years with a Bridgerton-style masquerade gala featuring themed decor and dancing.

item.title: Palm Beach Zoo extends Kids Free program through August 10
item.description: Palm Beach Zoo extended its Kids Free promotion through August 10, allowing up to four children ages 3 to 12 to receive free admission with one adult ticket.

item.title: Donalds holds commanding lead over Collins and Fishback in Florida Republican gubernatorial primary polling
item.description: Republican U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds holds a commanding advantage in polling and fundraising as Florida's August 18 gubernatorial primary approaches, while Democrat David Jolly has consolidated support in his party's contest.

item.title: Florida families shop tax-free back-to-school holiday through Aug. 20
item.description: Families across the Palm Beaches and Treasure Coast are shopping during the tax-free holiday to save money on school supplies, clothing and electronics before the Aug. 10 first day of school.

item.title: Security First Insurance lowers Florida homeowners rates by average of 5.6 percent, launches disappearing deductible program
item.description: Security First Insurance is lowering homeowners insurance rates by an average of 5.6 percent, the latest in a series of rate decreases the Florida-based company has made over the last two years as state reforms reduce lawsuits.

item.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth backs low-altitude military flyovers after Blue Angels jet buzzes Pensacola beach
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth defended low-altitude military flyovers after a Blue Angels jet flew so low over a crowded Pensacola beach Wednesday that chairs and tents went flying and sand kicked up, prompting a Navy safety review that was quickly curtailed.

item.title: Childcare costs exceed affordability benchmark for 85 percent of Florida families, Federal Reserve study finds
item.description: The majority of Florida families are estimated to spend more than 7 percent of their income on childcare, according to a new Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta report.

item.description: The Florida Department of Health reports 94 confirmed cases of cyclosporiasis statewide, with two cases in St Lucie County and one in Martin County. Two cases were also confirmed in Palm Beach County.

item.title: 12-year-old released from hospital after Midway Road dirt bike crash killed 9-year-old
item.description: The 12-year-old injured in Monday's fatal dirt bike crash on Midway Road has been released from the hospital and is recovering at home.

item.description: The Fort Pierce Police Department is investigating a shooting at Sugar and Spice Restaurant on Okeechobee Road Monday evening that left multiple bullet holes but no injuries.
